species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–30 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 49°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–32 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southeast wind at 8 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
